results.title: U.S. 🇺🇸 Congressman James P. McGovern has urged Secretary of State Marco Rubio to impose new economic sanctions on Burkina Faso 🇧🇫, Mali 🇲🇱,
results.description:
U.S. 🇺🇸 Congressman James P. McGovern has urged Secretary of State Marco Rubio to impose new economic sanctions on Burkina Faso 🇧🇫, Mali 🇲🇱, and Niger 🇳🇪, accusing their governments of human rights abuses.

This from a Democrat, and from a US that propose to livestream the execution of a human being? Give me a break.

The move comes as the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) pursues greater sovereignty, takes control of strategic natural resources, ends French military presence, and invests in national development.

Western sanctions are a form of economic warfare that harms ordinary citizens while putting pressure on governments that challenge foreign influence.

All the Sanction they imposed on Burkina Faso has failed. The more sanctions they imposed the higer the growth rate of the Burkinabe economy.

The new strategy is to befriend Burkina Faso.

🌍 Les États-Unis saluent la récente rencontre, à Dakar, entre l’Alliance des États du Sahel (AES) et la Communauté économique des États de l’Afrique de l’Ouest (CEDEAO). Cette rencontre publique de haut niveau constitue un premier pas vers la coopération entre les deux blocs.

results.title: Western forces left when asked: France/US withdrew from Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Chad, Senegal and Ivory Coast after government requests.
results.description: Western forces left when asked: France/US withdrew from Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Chad, Senegal and Ivory Coast after government requests. Presence rested on bilateral deals that end. Aid is voluntary, offered with conditions; recipients can refuse it and donors can suspend it. No verified Western threats of attack solely for expelling troops while retaining aid. Past ECOWAS warnings after coups targeted restoring elected rule and did not produce invasions.
